Hi team  following up with a concrete technical-eval plan and proposed success criteria / responsibilities. See inline and attached benchmark template.

Technical evaluation plan (summary):
- Objective: Run an apples-to-apples benchmark across a prioritized model shortlist and infra configs to validate:
  1) Functional quality on Acme's prompt set (accuracy, hallucination rate, instruction-following)
  2) Inference latency under expected QPS (cold start and steady-state metrics)
  3) Unit cost per 1M tokens at target throughput

Model shortlist (initial):
- Mistral-Instruct-7B (best-in-class efficiency for instruction tasks)
- OpenLlama-7B-Instruct-Quant (fast, low-cost baseline)
- Llama2-13B-Chat (strong quality baseline; quantized variant for cost)
- Redwood-Server-13B-Opt (our optimized serving variant with kernel-level optimizations)

Benchmark success criteria (proposed pass/fail):
- Quality: top-line accuracy > 85% on labeled evaluation prompts; hallucination rate < 5% on factual tests.
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 measured at 2x expected steady-state QPS (your production projection) with target p95 <= 180 ms and p99 < 350 ms for 256-token prompts. For 512-token end-to-end flows, p95 <= 320 ms.
- Cost: measured token cost per 1M tokens using Redwood's benchmark harness; target <= $400 / 1M tokens (equivalent to ~$0.40 / 1k tokens) for the production config.
- Operational: model must support KV cache persistence and warmup behavior that meets your session retention expectations.

Milestones & responsibilities:
- Tue 3/30 (Acme): Share expanded eval dataset (1k prompts) + acceptance criteria mapping (owner: John).
- Wed 3/31 10:00 AM PST (Redwood/Acme kickoff): Handoff & runbook review (owner: Marissa + Camila).
- Week of 4/5: Redwood runs initial benchmarks across shortlist on hosted infra and returns summary report with raw metrics (owner: Camila).
- Week of 4/12: Joint runs on Acme sample traffic pattern (dedicated pool or VPC) to validate latency under real QPS (owner: Acme + Redwood infra engs).
- 4/20: Decision meeting to pick model and infra target; update MAP and lock procurement path (owner: Marissa / John).

Dependencies / open items:
- Procurement: if Dedicated or Private deployment is chosen, we'll need SLA/commercial approval in parallel  Marissa to coordinate.
- Security: John, please confirm the exact SOC2 evidence items you require; we'll prepare KMS/HSM and logs docs for the security review.
- Dataset availability: Acme to provide full eval dataset and any sensitive redaction instructions.

Attachments: redwood_benchmark_template.xlsx (population guide + metrics dashboard), acme_eval_dataset_sample.csv

I'm copying David for infra planning and can schedule a short tech kickoff with our infra lead if helpful.

Thanks,
